explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 121 named tracks and releases across Juno's September 15 same-day techno page, current weekly electro and experimental/electronic windows, Bleep's overlooked catalogue listings, and artist/label-hosted exact-track pages. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: The canonical ledger, annotations, journey map, discussion and revisit queues, rejected and discovery histories, inspiration files, publication state and global utility ledger were audited first. UTF-8, JSON, count, map-order, receipt and protected-order checks passed; no objective defect, listener authorization, triggered revisit or unfinished repair required REPAIR.

Every canonical, previously evaluated, active PARKED, placement-specific REJECT and previously unresolved exact artist/title identity was excluded. Nine fresh exact-title leads remain; no ranking slot was filled for resolver convenience.
The recurring-PARK evidence guard was applied. One lead per release was retained, and every selected release has materially distinct exact-track prose or an exact artist-hosted listing.
Planned placements were compared with the previous five completed discovery runs. Recently evaluated boundaries were avoided, while incomplete requests remained excluded from musical evidence.
Generic preorders, unreviewed listings, prestige-only reissues, persistent identities and tracks supported only by genre labels were inspected but excluded.

Source descriptions remain attributed prose, not measurements. No energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, mixability or transition quality was inferred. Neither listener-protected handoff was split.

Rank reflects evidence specificity, selection-lens relevance, canonical potential and information gain, not novelty, orthodoxy, diversity, technical cleverness, artist prestige or a fixed chapter map.
sourceWindows: CURRENT: Juno's September 15 same-day techno page exposed 34 releases, including five reviewed records; ANGAMA, Bliss Inc and Jay Tripwire supplied exact differentiated propositions, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno-music/today/

ADJACENT / EMERGING: Juno's weekly electro window supplied 15 releases, including six reviewed records; Nick Fasoli, Calagad 13, AZARYC and Darren Nye supplied exact differentiated propositions, checked 2026-09-15. https://www.juno.co.uk/electro/this-week/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / LEFTFIELD: Bleep, Timedance, artist-hosted Bandcamp and current experimental/electronic listings supplied Lurka and Howie B/Hiraki Sawa propositions outside the repeated techno-restock source family, checked 2026-09-15. https://bleep.com/ and https://timedance.music/
